name: Max
quote: That tingling sensation, is a sign for the ensnaring electric shock soon to follow.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning! Why are you looking at me? I'm not talking to you!

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Wardenclyffe makes these zapping noises every afternoon.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Crackle! The lightning sparkles!

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Hmm... I'm so sleepy...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: N... no! I'm not sloppy! Ugh, why is this happening? I should have buttoned it up correctly...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: If I turn the voltage up to 1000 volts, I should be able to cook this rib all the way through. Shucks. It's burnt!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Did you fall asleep? Hehehe... I'll have Wardenclyffe wake you up.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: The power system has failed again! Ugh, this is so annoying. What? You want to go fix it with me? Fine, you can come... Just don't get in the way.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Aah!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: What are you looking at?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: What do you want?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: I really don't want to do it, but I guess I have no choice.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Hey, why did it take you so long to find me? Name's Max. I'm an expert when it comes to electromagnetism, and don't you forget it!

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: The power transmission rate is up!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Electromagnetic experiments are super dangerous. Don't forget your rubber boots and insulated clothing.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Isn't it beautiful whenever these strong currents collide and give off a burst of dazzling sparks? I'm the only one who can create such a marvelous sight!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Coils activated!

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: My electrodes are ready!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: 2000 volts of electricity, coming right up!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: I've burned them into charcoal!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Consider. It. Done!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I can't fall here...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Whoa, you caught me off guard! I don't really know what an oath is. I guess it's like a game of some sort?  I'll accept your offer then... Huh? Am I feeling happy, you ask? O-of course not, I'm not feeling anything in particular, dummy!

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Ugh... I don't want to participate in New Year's cleaning! You can do it for me, can't you, Professor?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: D-don't get me wrong! I'm only giving you chocolate as a reward! Anyway, since you've accepted it, you'll have to obey my every command from now on!

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Honeydew is way better than watermelon. You can put it in a milkshake, or wrap it in ham. It's great no matter what. W-wait a minute! Leave me a slice too!

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Why do I have to wear this heavy pumpkin suit?! I can't even walk in this... Ow! It hurts!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Speaking of Christmas staples, it's fried spare ribs and honeydew milkshakes! What, you don't believe me? It's true because I said so!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Ugh, this is so heavy... Professor, lend me a hand. Oh right, this here is your birthday gift from me. A box filled with ripe and plump honeydews, accept it!

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: First I put on my insulation suit, rubber boots, and rubber gloves. Then I'll carefully turn on the equipment and adjust the output. It's so beautiful when you see those bright sparks erupting from the tower coils as a white-hot ball of light forms at the top. My only complaint would be... I feel like I'm burning up in this insulation suit!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Whew... I only realized I was drenched in sweat once I crawled out of my insulation suit. It looks like I've just come back from a swim. Hey, what are you looking at? You think it's funny seeing me exhausted like this?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
You want to chat with me? Fine, but I have a small request...
Can you bring me a honeydew milkshake?  Don't add too much sugar, it overpowers all the other flavors. You got all that? Then hurry up and buy me one, chop chop!

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Now that you've brought me what I asked, I'm going to share some of my best gossip with you. Don't tell anyone else! What? Why do I know so much? Well, it shouldn't matter to you, maybe?...

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Hmm... Do you have any other questions?
If you want to learn more interesting stuff from me, hehehe... Perhaps we can make a deal?

career:
The EMR was created at the end of World War 3. It is a scientist Doll aimed at researching electromagnetism and related fields to develop new energy sources and military weapons. The EMR's body is covered with high-performance insulation materials which are replaced regularly to ensure safety during high-risk experiments.

Max was purchased and awoken by the dean of the Tantoin School of Electromagnetism. Her name was a reflection of his expectations of her, which Max passed with flying colors. She completed several experiments by herself and in a team before being recommended by the dean to enter 42Lab's Institute of Electromagnetism. 

Later, due to the sensitive nature and demanding requirements of her new project, she joined Project Neural Cloud and migrated most of the project to the cloud.
infoStories:
On her first day at 42Lab's Institute of Electromagnetism, Max managed to violate rules 5, 7, 12, and 36 of the institute's etiquette guidelines by crashing into the entrance guard, mouthing off, and performing various other colorful infractions. She became the "Legendary Doll" around the institute for having been written up so much without even having clocked in. 

"Me, a researcher's kid? Get the person in charge out here! Who do you think you're talking to... I'm a professional! A Doll! Not some human child!"
—42Lab's Institute of Electromagnetism Disciplinary Department Incident Report

Perhaps because the Institute of Electromagnetism resembles a school rather than a military complex, as long as one doesn't cross any red lines, their punishment tends to be fairly light. 

When Max, who had been keenly aware of the situation since she arrived, heard of her punishment, she completely let herself go. She dressed in a slovenly manner, clocked in whenever she pleased, and only occasionally registered her use of materials. Even when attending external project update meetings, she gave no regard to her appearance. It eventually got to the point where she was giving project speeches with a pointer in one hand and a lunch box in the other. 

For Max, nothing really matters besides experiments. If it can be solved in parallel, then solve it in parallel and save some time. Considering her outstanding research capabilities, the supervising administrators have no choice but to leave her be.

Perhaps the only regulations that Max takes seriously and follows dutifully are laboratory precautions.

Among all types of scientific experiments, electromagnetic experiments rank among the most dangerous. Adding to the danger, is the fact that most of the projects that fall into Max's hands are military-related.

Accidents during experiments are already commonplace for Max. Even when experiment regulations are strictly followed, accidents are unavoidable. If it weren't for the fact that Max is a Doll, she would already be listed on the Institute of Electromagnetism's memorial.

It is precisely because of this that Max treats experiments more strictly than anyone else. Outside the laboratory she is indifferent to everything, but inside she will not allow anyone to be negligent in even the most basic of procedures.

Nevertheless, in the short period of time since Max joined 42Lab, she has suffered from multiple accidents leading to severe body damage. According to logistics records, Max has replaced her body's insulation material up to 115 times.

Besides experiments, there is actually one more thing that piques Max's interest.

There's a saying that goes around the institute that the unit of measure for electromagnetism is Gaussian units, and the unit of measure for gossip is the Max mood unit.

The speed and efficiency by which gossip spreads as well as the gossip's breadth all fluctuate depending on Max's mood. There's no one rule to determine what will happen.

For example, the secret that Dr. Sim, responsible for leading electromagnetic wave research, is actually bald and wears a wig was accidentally leaked when Max was in a good mood, having just gotten results in her project.

Alternatively, the diagram detailing inter-office romances was designed when Max was in a bad mood after her experiment funds were cut and she was looking to distract herself.

The accident that occurred during the Project Neural Cloud test left Max stranded in the Magrasea cloud. Here, her tasks are to go out and assist the team or stay in the Oasis to handle trivial tasks. Experimentation time has taken a massive hit.

Initially, this made Max very uncomfortable, and she applied for some operand to make a portable simulation space where she could perform some small-scale electromagnetic experiments from time to time.

However, as she came in contact with, and experienced more and more things, she gradually found joy outside of experiments. She was able to hold conversations about things besides formulas, theorems, and other concepts that flew over others' heads.

"It's like... in experiments there are always variables. Since this is how things are now, there's no use in being anxious, right?"
—Doll Discussion Recording

projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Surge, O currents, surge! Let the sparkles of light fly high!"

"Surge, O currents, surge! Let the sparkles of light fly high!"

projections.name: Symphony of Resonant Resistance
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"All the great principles we've witnessed will continue to exist indefinitely—but that doesn't mean we have to keep working forever too, does it?"

skinList.name: Low Frequency Induction α
skinList.desc: The first awakening of a Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection—"Need me to get to work right away? Then I want a honeydew milkshake to pump me up first. Yawn..."

skinList.name: Electrical Spark Spray
skinList.desc:
From the "Seaside Concerto" series — an exquisite intersection of fashion and the human body's dynamics. Boldly show yourself off and enjoy yourself to your hearts' content amidst the azure waves.
Max was feeling down because she couldn't go on the beach holiday with everyone, but then inspiration struck and she inflated a little pool of her own.
"Argh! Why is my watergun wobbling all over the place and getting all over me!?"

skinList.name: Wishing Projection
skinList.desc:
Warming fireworks fill the silent night, and as the embers fall, they transform into countless candleflames. This is the most beautiful scene that the Dolls left behind on a Qixi summer night.
"Come over and hold my hand. Your company at the beach and the watermelons are keeping me in a good mood."
